translations.translatedText: # Sunday 9.7.2017 (radio)

The Iraqi army has taken control of the city of Mosul. There is an attempt to get a ceasefire in southwestern Syria. Police are getting new roadside speed cameras. Valtteri Bottas won the F1 race in Austria. Teijo Lindström is the new tango king.
## Mosul to the Iraqi army
![Members of the Iraqi police forces show the victory sign.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9713891)
Open image viewer
Iraq has defeated ISIS in Mosul. Photo: Ahmad Al-Rubaye / AFP
The Iraqi army has won an important victory over the terrorist organisation ISIS.
The army has driven ISIS out of the city of Mosul. Iraq's Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi announced this.
The prime minister travelled to Mosul on Sunday. He congratulated the Iraqi soldiers on the victory.
The Iraqi army fought against ISIS in Mosul for 9 months. Thousands of ordinary people also died in the fighting. Almost a million people fled from Mosul.
## A ceasefire for southwestern Syria
![Destruction caused by a car bomb in Damascus.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9712607)
Open image viewer
The marks of the war can be seen in Syria's capital, Damascus. Photo: Louai Beshara / AFP
There is an attempt to get a ceasefire in Syria. The aim is for the fighting to end in the southwestern Syria region. Southwestern Syria includes, for example, Syria's capital Damascus.

Russia, the USA and Syria's neighbour Jordan agreed on the ceasefire. In the Syrian war, Russia supports the Syrian government and the USA supports the Syrian rebels. Russia says that Russian military police will monitor the ceasefire.

The ceasefire began on Sunday. In the coming days we will see whether the fighting ends in southwestern Syria. There have already been many attempts to end the fighting in Syria, but the war has always continued.
## Roadside speed cameras for the police
![A speed camera by the side of the road.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9131901)
Open image viewer
A roadside camera monitors the speed of cars. Photo: Kaisa Siren / AOP
Police are getting new roadside speed cameras.
A roadside camera, or "tin policeman", monitors traffic. The roadside camera takes a picture of a car that is driving too fast. Many drivers have got fines because of roadside cameras.
Police are buying 150 new roadside cameras. That is a lot, because the police now have 130 roadside cameras.
The new roadside cameras will appear beside roads over the next 3 years.
## An F1 win for Valtteri Bottas
![Valtteri Bottas.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9713834)
Open image viewer
Valtteri Bottas was the best F1 driver in the Austrian race. Photo: AOP
The Finnish Formula driver Valtteri Bottas is doing well. Bottas won the F1 car race in Austria on Sunday.
This was Bottas's second F1 win. He won the Russian F1 race in April.
Valtteri Bottas now races in a Mercedes car.
## Tango king Teijo Lindström
![Teijo Lindström.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9713471)
Open image viewer
Teijo Lindström is the new tango king. Photo: Timo Aalto / Lehtikuva
The big Finnish music event Tangomarkkinat (the Tango Festival) has ended in Seinäjoki. On Saturday male singers competed in tango singing.
The winner of the competition is Teijo Lindström. He became this year's tango king. The new tango king comes from Orimattila.
The tango queen was already chosen on Thursday. This year's tango queen is Aino Niemi.
The Tango Festival is a music event that is over 30 years old. The Tango Festival is held in Seinäjoki every summer.
